ResearchProjectDef.label: folding with qi
ResearchProjectDef.description: How to fold spirit steel with qi without cracking it. Gan Jiang is said to have failed for three years until Mo Ye taught him to breathe with the bellows. Allows upgrading the spirit forge to level 2 (spears and bows).

ResearchProjectDef.label: spirit treasures
ResearchProjectDef.description: How to give a weapon a spirit of its own. The Formless Sword Sect believes a treasure is never forged, only awakened, and that its spirit chooses its master. Allows upgrading the spirit forge to level 3 (treasures such as the flying sword).

ResearchProjectDef.label: controlled fire
ResearchProjectDef.description: How to hold the fire of the furnace steady for days. The Heavenly Cauldron Pavilion makes its apprentices watch a single flame for a whole season before they may touch the bellows. Allows upgrading the alchemy furnace to level 2 (mid-grade pills).

ResearchProjectDef.label: pill tribulation
ResearchProjectDef.description: The greatest pills call down a small tribulation of their own when they form. Shennong's last disciple is said to have survived it by holding the furnace lid down with his own hands. Allows upgrading the alchemy furnace to level 3 (high-grade pills such as the nine-turns pill).
